specification.title: Workmanship acceptance specification: PCB1 and PCB4 assemblies

notes.protocol: every figure is defined in eval/PROTOCOL.md, written before the run; its digest at the time of the run is under `protocol`
notes.proportions: count of n; rate, low and high are fractions of 1; low and high are the 95% Wilson score interval, z = 1.959964, no continuity correction
notes.citation: the heading id in the judge's validated answer about region 1, the most anomalous area; an image with no citation counts as wrong
notes.units: *_seconds and seconds are wall-clock seconds; *_mib is MiB as nvidia-smi reports it; minutes are seconds / 60; anomaly scores and thresholds are raw PatchCore distances
notes.percentiles: numpy.percentile, linear interpolation between the ranked values
notes.cold: every request was sent with cache_prompt false: the whole prompt is evaluated
notes.corrections: no correction was recalled into any prompt; `leak` counts the decisions and how many of them had a correction in a prompt, which must be none
notes.not_held_out: the anomaly model's thresholds were chosen on the same test split, and the judge's prompt was written with sight of some of its images: see eval/PROTOCOL.md
notes.inspector: parse time is measured in this run and includes loading the parser's models; fit time is the one recorded when each part's model was trained, not repeated here
